minimum_environment: Existing authorized Linux x86_64 cgroup v2 environment with cpu, memory and io enabled under /sys/fs/cgroup, permission to create an isolated child and set cpu.max/memory.max/memory.swap.max/io.max, cgroup.kill, block-device I/O accounting and libseccomp notification support. Keep original test assertions.
scope_count_method: Unique inspected cgroup directories, root included once
